_README: What members pay for merch and events, and when. EDIT THIS FILE, not Python.
An incoming Venmo or Zelle with no memo keyword, inside an event's dates, at
exactly one of its prices, is booked to that event's committee. A memo that
names a committee ('merch', 'formal') still wins; this only catches the
payments people send without saying what they are for.
start/end : inclusive dates the payments arrive between.
amounts   : every price a member can pay, including bundles.
OVERLAPS: when a payment fits two events, the one listed FIRST wins. Keep the
shorter, memo-less one first. Fall 2026: $40 is both a merch bundle and a
semi-formal ticket with a date. 13 of 15 merch payers wrote a memo; the
semi-formal form asks for none, so a bare $40 after 10/20 is Formal.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored.
